import re
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

TOK = re.compile(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|__.+?__|\*.+?\*)")

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.page_width = Inches(8.5); sec.page_height = Inches(11)
    for m in ("left_margin","right_margin","top_margin","bottom_margin"):
        setattr(sec, m, Inches(1))
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Times New Roman"; st.font.size = Pt(12)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
    pf = st.paragraph_format
    pf.space_after = Pt(0); pf.space_before = Pt(0)
    add_page_number(sec)
    return d

def add_page_number(sec):
    p = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = p.add_run()
    for kind, txt in (("begin", None), (None, "PAGE"), ("end", None)):
        if kind:
            e = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); e.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), kind); r._r.append(e)
        else:
            e = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); e.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); e.text = txt; r._r.append(e)
    r.font.size = Pt(10)

def runs(p, text, size=None, bold=None, italic=None):
    for part in TOK.split(text):
        if not part: continue
        b = i = u = False; t = part
        if part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**") and len(part) > 4: b = True; t = part[2:-2]
        elif part.startswith("__") and part.endswith("__") and len(part) > 4: u = True; t = part[2:-2]
        elif part.startswith("*") and part.endswith("*") and len(part) > 2: i = True; t = part[1:-1]
        r = p.add_run(t)
        r.bold = True if (b or bold) else None
        r.italic = True if (i or italic) else None
        r.underline = True if u else None
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def para(d, text="", align="justify", indent=0.5, spacing=2.0, after=0, before=0, size=None, bold=None, italic=None, left=0, keep=False):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.alignment = {"justify": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY, "center": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER,
                    "left": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, "right": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT}[align]
    pf.first_line_indent = Inches(indent) if indent else None
    pf.left_indent = Inches(left) if left else None
    pf.line_spacing = spacing
    pf.space_after = Pt(after); pf.space_before = Pt(before)
    if keep: pf.keep_with_next = True
    runs(p, text, size=size, bold=bold, italic=italic)
    return p

def heading(d, text, level=1):
    if level == 1:
        p = para(d, "", align="center", indent=0, spacing=1.0, before=12, after=12, keep=True)
        r = p.add_run(text); r.bold = True
    elif level == 2:
        p = para(d, "", align="left", indent=0, spacing=1.0, before=6, after=12, keep=True, left=0.5)
        p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(-0.5)
        runs(p, text, bold=True)
    else:
        p = para(d, "", align="left", indent=0, spacing=1.0, before=6, after=12, keep=True, left=1.0)
        p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(-0.5)
        runs(p, text, bold=True, italic=True)
    return p

def block(d, text, left=1.0, right=1.0):
    p = para(d, text, align="justify", indent=0, spacing=1.0, after=12, left=left)
    p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(right)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, left=1.0, hang=0.5, spacing=1.0, after=8, label=None):
    p = para(d, "", align="justify", indent=0, spacing=spacing, after=after, left=left)
    p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Inches(-hang)
    lab = label if label is not None else "•"
    p.add_run(lab + "\t")
    p.paragraph_format.tab_stops.add_tab_stop(Inches(left))
    runs(p, text)
    return p

def page_break(d):
    p = d.add_paragraph(); p.add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def set_cell_border(cell, **kw):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    b = tcPr.find(qn("w:tcBorders"))
    if b is None:
        b = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders"); tcPr.append(b)
    for edge in ("top","left","bottom","right"):
        if edge in kw:
            e = OxmlElement("w:"+edge)
            for k, v in kw[edge].items(): e.set(qn("w:"+k), str(v))
            b.append(e)

def no_borders(table):
    tbl = table._tbl
    tblPr = tbl.tblPr
    borders = OxmlElement("w:tblBorders")
    for edge in ("top","left","bottom","right","insideH","insideV"):
        e = OxmlElement("w:"+edge); e.set(qn("w:val"), "nil"); borders.append(e)
    tblPr.append(borders)

def cell_text(cell, lines, align="left", size=12, spacing=1.0):
    cell.paragraphs[0].text = ""
    first = True
    for ln in lines:
        p = cell.paragraphs[0] if first else cell.add_paragraph()
        first = False
        p.paragraph_format.alignment = {"left": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, "center": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER, "right": WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT}[align]
        p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = spacing
        runs(p, ln, size=size)

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    tbl = table._tbl
    grid = tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i]*1440)))
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, c in enumerate(row.cells):
            c.width = Inches(widths[i])

def caption(d, title):
    para(d, "**UNITED STATES BANKRUPTCY COURT**", align="center", indent=0, spacing=1.0)
    para(d, "**FOR THE DISTRICT OF OREGON**", align="center", indent=0, spacing=1.0)
    para(d, "**PORTLAND DIVISION**", align="center", indent=0, spacing=1.0, after=12)
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    no_borders(t)
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_col_widths(t, [3.4, 3.1])
    l, r = t.rows[0].cells
    cell_text(l, ["In re:", "", "**CASCADIA TIMBER HOLDINGS, INC.,**", "an Oregon corporation,", "EIN 93-1284756,", "", "                                        *Debtor.*"])
    set_cell_border(l, right={"val":"single","sz":"6","color":"000000"}, bottom={"val":"single","sz":"6","color":"000000"})
    cell_text(r, ["   Case No. 22-30847-PCW", "", "   Chapter 11", "", "   Hon. Patricia C. Wellborne", "", ""] + ["   " + x for x in title])
    para(d, "", spacing=1.0, after=6)

def grid_table(d, header, rows, widths, size=10, bold_last=False):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1+len(rows), cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        cell_text(t.rows[0].cells[i], ["**"+h+"**"], size=size)
        shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), "D9D9D9")
        t.rows[0].cells[i]._tc.get_or_add_tcPr().append(shd)
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        for ci, v in enumerate(row):
            txt = ("**"+v+"**") if (bold_last and ri == len(rows)-1 and v) else v
            cell_text(t.rows[ri+1].cells[ci], [txt], size=size)
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    para(d, "", spacing=1.0, after=6)
    return t

heading(d, "A.\tLegal Standard", 2)
N("Section 350(a) provides: “After an estate is fully administered and the court has discharged the trustee, the court shall close the case.” 11 U.S.C. § 350(a). Bankruptcy Rule 3022 implements that directive in chapter 11 cases: once the estate is fully administered, the court, on its own or on the motion of a party in interest, must enter a final decree closing the case. Fed. R. Bankr. P. 3022. No trustee was appointed in this case, so no discharge of a trustee is required.")
N("Neither the Bankruptcy Code nor the Rules define “fully administered.” The Advisory Committee Note to the 1991 amendment of Rule 3022 identifies factors the court should consider, including: (1) whether the order confirming the plan has become final; (2) whether deposits required by the plan have been distributed; (3) whether the property proposed by the plan to be transferred has been transferred; (4) whether the debtor or the successor of the debtor under the plan has assumed the business or the management of the property dealt with by the plan; (5) whether payments under the plan have commenced; and (6) whether all motions, contested matters, and adversary proceedings have been finally resolved. Fed. R. Bankr. P. 3022 advisory committee’s note to 1991 amendment. The UST Guidelines add whether the plan has been substantially consummated under section 1101(2), whether administrative claims (including professional compensation) have been resolved and paid, and the U.S. Trustee’s position. UST Guidelines § II.")
N("These factors are guidelines, not a checklist; not every factor must be present, and the inquiry turns on the totality of the circumstances. *See, e.g.*, *In re Union Home & Indus., Inc.*, 375 B.R. 912, 916–17 (B.A.P. 10th Cir. 2007); *In re Gates Cmty. Chapel of Rochester, Inc.*, 212 B.R. 220, 224 (Bankr. W.D.N.Y. 1997); *In re Mold Makers, Inc.*, 124 B.R. 766, 768–69 (Bankr. N.D. Ill. 1990). The Advisory Committee Note emphasizes that entry of a final decree “should not be delayed solely because the payments required by the plan have not been completed,” and that the court should not keep a case open “only because of the possibility that the court’s jurisdiction may be invoked in the future.” Fed. R. Bankr. P. 3022 advisory committee’s note to 1991 amendment. A final decree does not deprive the court of jurisdiction to enforce or interpret its own orders, and the case may be reopened for cause under section 350(b). *Id.*; *see* 11 U.S.C. § 350(b). Courts thus regard a case as fully administered when the plan has been substantially consummated and the matters that remain are ministerial or are governed by the plan and can be carried out by the reorganized debtor without court supervision. *See In re Kliegl Bros. Universal Elec. Stage Lighting Co.*, 238 B.R. 531, 542 (Bankr. E.D.N.Y. 1999); *In re Federated Dep’t Stores, Inc.*, 43 F. App’x 820, 822–23 (6th Cir. 2002). [Cite-check; add controlling Ninth Circuit/District of Oregon authority if available.]")
